text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono hopes her regular cooking 
streams will inspire all her fans to take 
a greater interest in her races!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Following that plan, she appears on UmaSta 
Live. The stream is a huge hit, drawing 
even more attention to Hishi Akebono from 
the fans she gained from her race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Let's keep this momentum going and aim to 
win over even more fans!
